related_resources.reason: Full accessible journal text on settlement mapping, magnetometry, waterfront and probable early mosque. Geophysical identification of worship space is interpretive.
Uppsala doctoral dissertation record: surface surveys, more than 200 cores, early occupation and trade. Abstract viewed; technical tables not independently reviewed.
Institutional research record and abstract confirm two less-than-forty-year house phases and episodic occupation; the site-wide implication is an interpretation.
Peer-reviewed abstract on faunal assemblages at Fukuchani and Unguja Ukuu, fishing, introduced animals, contrasts in wild and domestic prey. Sampling is site-specific.
Full open archaeological prospection article, including comparison of ground/remote sensing and 1990s records. Modern landscapes cannot stand for ancient shorelines.
